content.title: Runner
content.overview: A former soldier is thrown into a brutal race against time when a critical medical delivery makes him and his unlikely partner the targets of a ruthless cartel. As the mission spirals into a deadly manhunt, every detour, delay, and bullet pushes them closer to failure. With betrayal closing in from every side, they must survive the chase and deliver their cargo to save the life of a little girl.

Title: Runner

Tagline: Next-day delivery isn't an option.

Overview: A former soldier is thrown into a brutal race against time when a critical medical delivery makes him and his unlikely partner the targets of a ruthless cartel. As the mission spirals into a deadly manhunt, every detour, delay, and bullet pushes them closer to failure. With betrayal closing in from every side, they must survive the chase and deliver their cargo to save the life of a little girl.

Genres: Action, Comedy, Thriller

Production Companies: Broken Road Productions, AllyCat Entertainment, Nickel City Pictures, A Higher Standard, G2 Dispatch, Angel Studios, International Media Funds Management, Bright White Light

Production Countries: United States of America, Australia, United Kingdom

Spoken Languages: English, Portuguese
